Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee

September 16-17, 2025
A joint meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee and the Board of Governors was held on Tuesday, September 16, 2025.

Developments in Financial Markets and Open Market Operations
The deputy manager turned first to an overview of financial market developments during the intermeeting period.

Participants agreed that uncertainty about the economic outlook remained elevated.

Last Update: October 8, 2025
